create.name: Riley Lee
create.bio:
Riley Lee is a shakuhachi player and teacher who has lived in Australia since 1986 and is based near Manly, New South Wales. Born in Texas and raised partly in Hawaii, he went to Japan in the early 1970s, began studying the bamboo flute with Chikuho Sakai, and in 1980 was made a dai shihan, or grand master, later studying with Katsuya Yokoyama. He toured for several years with the drum group Ondekoza, then taught at the University of Hawaii before earning a doctorate in ethnomusicology at the University of Sydney, writing on how the Zen repertoire of the instrument, the honkyoku, is handed down.

For him the shakuhachi is first a meditative practice built on the breath, and he has recorded a large catalogue of contemplative music. He gives online lessons by appointment to players of every level, from complete beginners to professionals, and keeps a password-protected archive of scores and recordings from his Chikuho lineage for students. Drawing on decades of breathing workshops, he has also made a self-paced course of simple conscious breathing exercises, with versions on Insight Timer, and writes short articles on playing, the instrument and its history.

courses.title: Shakuhachi lessons with Riley Lee
courses.description: Online one-to-one shakuhachi lessons of about an hour, booked by appointment, for beginners through to professional players. Riley can also help students find an instrument before their first lesson.

courses.title: Breathe! The Art of Breathing with Riley Lee
courses.description: A self-paced course of about two hours of simple conscious breathing exercises and teaching, drawn from his years of workshops. It comes with a fourteen-page PDF of the exercises in English or German.

courses.title: Membership Area for Shakuhachi Players
courses.description: A one-off fee opens a password-protected archive for students of the instrument. It holds more than fifty recordings and eighty scores of Chikuho lineage honkyoku passed to him by Sakai Chikuho II, with fingering charts and beginners' exercises.

courses.title: Breathe - The Simple Art Of Breathing
courses.description: An Insight Timer course of short daily sessions in which Riley guides simple exercises for becoming more aware of the breath. It is based on the breathing workshops he has led for decades.
courses.price: Included in Member Plus ($59.99 USD a year)

free_resources.title: Riley Lee on Insight Timer
free_resources.description: A large free collection of his meditative shakuhachi music, with some guided breathing practices. Free to listen to.

free_resources.title: Invocation Breath (free exercise)
free_resources.description: One of the exercises from his breathing course, offered free to try on the course page. A short guided practice in breathing with attention.

free_resources.title: Ongoing Study articles
free_resources.description: A set of free short articles for shakuhachi players and listeners, on topics such as producing the upper octave, choosing an instrument and the meditative honkyoku pieces.
